TOM MCDONALD & ASSOCIATES - EXPERIENCED, PROFESSIONAL, TRUSTED - are delighted to offer to the market this Wonderful, 4 Bed Family Home with Sunny, South-East Facing Rear Garden. Freshly Painted throughout, this Super Property is situated in a Private Cul-de-Sac overlooking a Large Green Area to the Front.

Located just a short distance to Portarlington Train Station, Schools, Shops, Town Centre & All Amenities.

Accommodation is comprised of Living Room, Kitchen/Diner and WC on the Ground Floor with 3 Bedrooms, En-Suite & Main Bathroom on the First Floor. There is an Expansive Double Room with En-Suite on the Second Floor completing the accommodation of this Ideal Family Home.

In the Spacious Living Room with Bay Window, Solid Timber Floor & French Doors to Kitchen/Diner there is a Feature Fireplace creating a Cosy Atmosphere in the Evening. The Kitchen/Diner with Tiled Floor & Newly Tiled Splashback has a Stylish Fitted Kitchen with Oven, Hob, Dryer & Dishwasher. There is Additional Storage in the Dining Area with further Fitted Units.

A New Gas Boiler was installed in Recent Years. 

Sliding Doors access the Sunny Rear Garden from the Dining Area with Space for Outdoor Dining.

There is a Newly Fitted Carpet on the Stairs & in All 4 Bedrooms which are Good Size Double Rooms. The Main Bedroom with Bay Window has an En-Suite with Pump Shower & New Vanity Unit. The Family Bathroom has an Overhead Shower & Panelling on Wall around Bath. Bedroom 3 has an Inlet Area which could be used as a study space in the bedroom or a Good Size Wardrobe. 

The Top Floor Bedroom with En-Suite (Electric Shower) is an Ideal Space for a Master Suite with Room for a Seating Area.  

This Property is a Must View! Let’s make it yours! 

Services: Mains Water, Sewerage, Electricity, Natural Gas & Broadband.

Built c. 2003. BER No. 104059522.
